description: A third order Butterworth low pass ladder filter, built as a wave digital filter that models the resistors, capacitors and inductors of the analogue circuit.

params.text: Sets the cutoff frequency, 20Hz to 20480Hz, starting at 261.63Hz.
Attenuates the cutoff CV input, and inverts it when turned below zero.

inputs.text: The audio to be filtered; sixteen channels are filtered separately.
Shifts the corner frequency by one octave per volt, scaled by its attenuverter.

notes: the cutoff CV input is multiplied by the attenuverter beside it, and it starts at zero, so a patched cable changes nothing until the attenuverter is turned up.
menu: Enable Warping — corrects the mismatch between the analogue corner frequency and the digital one, which the component equations otherwise leave uncorrected.
